selection.rule: Choose one pair per video under fixed pair-type, source-set, question-type-match, and stratum-by-model-by-arm correctness targets nearest to the complete 254-pair rates. Resolve feasible solutions using a fixed SHA-256-derived linear objective.

reporting_guardrail: This candidate set was selected using the same model outcomes summarized within it. Use it as a balanced candidate or qualitative set only, not as independent confirmatory evidence. Preserve the complete 100- and 254-pair analyses as the inferential results.
